title: Ukrainians are braced for a brutal winter. Are the Russians also ready?
gist: Peter Dickinson argues Ukraine faces potentially its toughest war winter as Patriot interceptor stocks (also drained by the US-led Iran campaign) run dangerously low and Russia scales ballistic missiles and new jet drones. But Ukraine's expanding strategic bombing campaign, including the record Sept 20 Moscow raid that hit the capital's main refinery, means Russians may face winter infrastructure hardship for the first time.
